“The proposed drive aisle and turnaround cross internal lot lines between parcels in unified ownership (St. Mary's Roman Catholic Congregation Inc., Block 5027, Lots 006, 007, 008, and 008A). In the event of any future construction of a building requiring fire apparatus access via this drive aisle, revised plans shall be submitted for review and approval prior to permit issuance.”
*******

work_class: .During an on-site consultation conducted on June 3, 2026, the inspector noted that the approved permit drawings show 2x10 roof rafters, while the roof was framed with 2x6 rafters. The inspector advised that the roof framing would need to be modified or otherwise supported to address the span of the existing 2x6 rafters.    In response, revised drawings were prepared showing the addition of a perpendicular mid-span support beam and supporting posts. The proposed modification is intended to reduce the effective span of the existing 2x6 rafters and address the framing concern identified during the consultation while maintaining the overall roof design.    This amendment is submitted for review and approval of the revised roof framing configuration. Separate permit will be required for electrical, mechanical, and plumbing work. As per plans and as per code.

project: Entertainment: Indoor - 12 N EUTAW ST
work_class:
LED Displays (Retro-fit into Marquee)Scope of Work:
Remove existing marquee sign faces and track lettering from two (2) existing double-face
marquee cabinets located at the Hippodrome Theatre, 12 N. Eutaw Street, Baltimore, MD.
Retrofit existing marquee structures with new digital LED display systems while maintaining and
reusing the existing perimeter bulb border cabinets, support framing, hanging rods, attachment
plates, and select structural components.
Install:
• Two (2) new outdoor-rated 6.67mm SMD LED digital marquee displays
• Each marquee display measures approximately 20’-5 11/16” W x 3’-1 13/16” H
• Total display area per side: approximately 64.6 sq. ft.
• Total combined display area: approximately 129.2 sq. ft.
Digital Display Components:
• Twelve (12) LED display cabinets total
o Six (6) LED cabinets per marquee
• Integrated steel Unistrut support framing:
o Four (4) horizontal Unistruts per marquee
o Six (6) vertical Unistruts per marquee
• Ten (10) aluminum mounting angles total
o Five (5) mounting angles per marquee
• Aluminum filler panels painted satin/matte black to infill perimeter gaps around displays
Electrical Work Includes:
• Installation of two (2) NEMA enclosures for surge suppression equipment
• Installation of required disconnect switches and liquid-tight conduit
• Connection to owner-provided 120V power circuits
• Total electrical load: 6,830 watts / 57.42 amps maximum
• Five (5) dedicated 20A / 120V circuits for displays
• One (1) additional 20A / 120V circuit for head-end equipment
Low Voltage/Data:
• Install CAT6 signal/data cabling between IDF room and both marquee displays
• Install required digital display control equipment and media player components

Exisiting conditions:• Existing marquee cabinets, perimeter bulb lighting, hanging rods, attachment plates,
and primary structural framing to remain and be reused where noted.
• No expansion of existing sign footprint.
• No changes to building structure beyond attachment of retrofit mounting components
to existing marquee framing.
Approximate Weight:
• Left marquee retrofit assembly: 480 lbs.
• Right marquee retrofit assembly: 480 lbs.

As per plans as per code

****** for SWO: Exterior Brick Repointing – 18,000 SF ******

SCOPE OF WORK:
 ------ EXTERIOR ALTERATIONS ------
 - Repoint approximately 18,000 square feet of existing exterior brick masonry. Work shall include removal of deteriorated mortar joints to the required depth, cleaning of joints, installation of new mortar compatible with the existing masonry, replacement of damaged or deteriorated bricks as required, and final cleaning of the masonry surfaces. All work shall be performed in accordance manufacturer specifications, and the current Baltimore City Building Code.
   AS PER PLANS AND AS PER CODE.

 ***** Prior to the commencement of work, a Lead Inspection/Risk Assessment shall be completed as required. Environmental dust control measures shall be implemented throughout the project, including containment, dust suppression, debris management, and proper disposal of construction waste in compliance with all applicable Baltimore City, Maryland Department of the Environment (MDE), EPA, and OSHA regulations. *******
  ******* The work is limited to exterior masonry restoration and shall not alter the structural integrity, occupancy classification, or use of the building. *****
